source_text: Salvatorem suscitavit Gothoniel — tempus mihi Dei. Spiritus Domini super eum; iudicavit Israel; quievit terra.
pass_a_gloss: Savior he-raised Othniel — time to-me of-God. Spirit of-Lord upon him; he-judged Israel; rested land.
pass_b_english: [[He raised a savior, Othniel >> Bible:Judges 3:9-11]] — “God’s time for me.” The Lord’s Spirit on him; he judged Israel; the land rested.
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
